notes.title: Full Release Imminent!
notes.notes: We'll be transitioning from Early Access to Full Release within the next week or two! We have lots of new things coming, such as two new enemies, balance updates, saving and loading progress, story and game introduction screens, revamped environments, new UI, overarching game loop, a couple new levels and more. We're really excited to roll these new features out to you all, so keep an eye here on Steam as we wrap up development and feel free to ask us questions on the forums. ːsteamhappyː
